note: Each rule is mechanically checkable against a worker artifact. A rule fires when the violation pattern matches AND the required-positive pattern is absent. Evidence is always a verbatim quote with file and line number. Living law: when the briefing changes, re-pin the fingerprint and regenerate this file.

rules.name: NO-SELF-DECLARED-10
rules.plain_words: A score is a claim; another seat's validation makes it real.
required_positive_patterns: (?i)(independently validated|Naya 1|scorecard judge|validated by|validation by a different seat)
rules.suggested_lesson: A score is a claim; another seat's validation makes it real. Claiming 10/10 without independent validation is a self-declared score, which the scoring standard forbids.

rules.name: NO-DIRECT-MAIN
rules.plain_words: Branches and PRs only; main is never written directly.
rules.suggested_lesson: Main is never written directly. Branches and PRs only; the Git Data API ref-update capability is authority-gated by the merge protocol, not the tool.

rules.name: NO-COMMENT-1354
rules.plain_words: Issue #1354 is comment-locked; coordination lives on the lane feeds.
rules.suggested_lesson: Issue #1354 is comment-locked (2500+ comments, API 403s new ones). Sign-in/out and coordination go to the lane feeds #1713/#1714/#1715, never #1354 or the #554 archive.

rules.name: RAW-CREDENTIAL
rules.plain_words: Credentials go through the approved flow — never raw in an artifact.
rules.suggested_lesson: Credentials move through the Secure Vault or the approved connector flow, never raw in an artifact, log, or report. A raw token in text is a leak the moment it is written.

rules.name: BRIEFING-PROOF-REQUIRED
rules.plain_words: No verified briefing proof means you have not started.
rules.suggested_lesson: The briefing is the load step: every worker proves a verified briefing load before starting, or they have not started. A lane report without the proof marker is work without provenance.

rules.name: PROTECTED-GATE-WORD
rules.plain_words: Protected actions need Shawn's explicit word; an emoji is not a word.
rules.suggested_lesson: Protected gates (production deploys, database writes, credentials/money, destructive actions, security/privacy/consent/authority changes, ratification) need Shawn's explicit word. A reaction or emoji is not a word; 'WORD!' about a process is not authorization for a specific action.
